LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldMaxEnergyFactor.label: aura capacity multiplier
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldMaxEnergyFactor.descript: Multiplier applied to Aura Ward's maximum capacity.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldRegenPerSecondFactor.des: Multiplier applied to aura regeneration per second.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldHitRegenDelayFactor.desc: Multiplier applied to aura regeneration delay after taking a hit.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldBreakDelayOffset.label: aura ward restart delay offset
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldBreakDelayOffset.descrip: Additive adjustment to the delay before regeneration resumes after aura is depleted.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldDamageCapFactor.label: aura per-hit cost cap multiplier
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldDamageCapFactor.descript: Multiplier applied to the aura cost cap per hit. Higher values raise the cap.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldDamageCapOffset.label: aura per-hit cost cap offset
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldDamageCapOffset.descript: Additive adjustment to the aura cost cap per hit, whose base value is 20. Applied before the multiplier; has no effect when the cost cap multiplier is 0%.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldHardening.label: Aura Hardening
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldHardening.description: Additional armor provided by Aura Hardening. Armor is subtracted from damage dealt to the shield; damage below the armor value is completely negated.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldHardeningFactor.label: aura hardening multiplier
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShieldHardeningFactor.descript: Multiplier applied to Aura Hardening's armor value. At 0, the armor has no effect.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecreeMaxOffset.label: flower decree maximum offset
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecreeMaxOffset.description: Additive adjustment to maximum Flower Decree.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecreeRegenFactor.label: flower decree regeneration multiplier
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecreeRegenFactor.descriptio: Multiplier applied to Flower Decree regeneration speed.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowingFormRechargeSpeedFactor.des: Multiplier applied to Flowing Form's recharge speed.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpellEffectFactor.label: spell effect factor
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpellEffectFactor.description: Multiplier applied to special spell effects. Affects Qinghe's ability damage, abnormal buildup applied by abilities and resonance, and the strength of ability buffs.
